name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the user explicitly requests the next APK update.
notes: Phase 346 adds a dedicated live avatar dressing room using the verified Eric and Claudia FBX bodies already present on main.
Eric is the default player body and Claudia is selectable; their poker-table NPC instances remain separate.
Profiles now display the saved avatar body and equipped outfit in a live Three.js preview.
Starter wardrobe equipment includes color themes, hats, eyewear, jackets, vests, hoodies, shoes, watches, chains, and badges.
The viewer supports FBX plus future GLB/glTF bodies and uses a safe procedural mannequin on load failure.
The same schema-versioned outfit record is shared with Android, Quest, PC, the secure Phase 345 profile API, and the future Unity client.
Camera 3 remains free of account and avatar activity modules.
The Android Phase 343 HUD, Phase 344 input lock, Phase 342 performance governor, and Phase 345 account activity remain preserved.
APK update prompts remain disabled and installation remains manual-only.
